newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Red Crescent to send quake aid to Iran.
newsitem.headline: Turk Red Crescent to send quake aid to Iran.

text.p: Turkey's Red Crescent Society said on Monday it would send two plane loads of emergency aid to help earthquake victims in neighbouring Iran.
"Twenty tonnes of materials are going to be sent this afternoon by two military planes," a society official told Reuters.
The relief aid includes 13 tonnes of food, 4,000 blankets and medical supplies, he said.

An earthquake measuring 4.8 on the Richter scale hit the cities of Ardabil and Nir in northwestern Iran on Monday, two days after a massive quake devastated the country's eastern region killing about 2,400 people and injuring 6,000.
There was no report on possible loss of life or damage to property in the latest quake.
Turkish officials are coordinating their efforts with their Iranian counterparts over the distribution of the aid, he said.

Quake-prone Iran, accustomed to dealing with natural disasters, on Sunday appealed through the United Nations for international aid to help relieve the suffering of survivors in 200 devastated villages.
Neighbouring Arab countries, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and the United Arab Emirates, have said they were flying in aid. The United States and France said they were ready to help. EU JON
